discard.title: Discard changes?
discard.body: Your unsaved changes will be lost.

cancel.title: Cancel this action?
cancel.body: Any unfinished changes will be lost.

restoreDefaults.title: Restore defaults?
restoreDefaults.body: Your custom settings will be replaced with the defaults.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: You will need to sign in again to use Kubri.

retry.title: Try again?
retry.body: Kubri will repeat the last safe action.
